items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: we had Jimmie Mundie writing for us, a great writer and arranger.

ctx.x: And I opened with Tommy; we were doing the Raleigh Kool Show at the same time, and I learned a great deal from
Tommy Dorsey -- this band that we played in was all styles of music, not only the great pretty sounds, ballad band -- but we had Jimmie Mundie writing for us, a great writer and arranger.
Now, he had previously worked for who?
